notes: Detection: read hw.model (sysctl) and match it against model_identifiers; that gives the model. Then read the Model Number from System Information (e.g. "MYD82LL/A") and look up its first 5 characters in that model's part_numbers; that gives the colour when the prefix is known. Build-to-order machines (Z-prefix) and regional/refurbished numbers are mostly not covered: when there is no match, show default_color and let the user choose. Identifiers shared by two models are listed in shared_identifiers; for those, use the part number prefix to pick the model, else ask the user.

field_notes.colors: Hex values are approximations. Apple publishes none; body_hex is sampled from Apple Store colour-swatch images, body_hex_dark is a computed darker shade, keyboard_hex is eyeballed.
field_notes.design.corner_radius_hint: Eyeballed drawing hint in mm at real scale; not measured or published by Apple. Treat as unverified for every model.
field_notes.design.ports_left/ports_right: Ordered rear (hinge) to front. Port sets come from Apple tech specs; side placement from Apple product imagery and descriptions; order within a side is approximate.
field_notes.design.dimensions_mm: From Apple tech specs (cm x 10). height_min is the thin front edge of the wedge designs.
field_notes.design.display_aspect: Native panel resolution from Apple tech specs; notch models include the menu-bar strip beside the notch.
field_notes.part_number_sources: apple-store = Apple Store product data (Nov 2026); everymac = everymac.com spec-page footnote (read via the Internet Archive). Every mapped prefix has at least one.
field_notes.part_numbers_color_unknown: Prefixes Apple lists for the model whose colour could not be confirmed; they identify the model but not the colour.
field_notes.unverified: design.unverified=true marks a design block with at least one field taken by analogy rather than from a source; design.unverified_note says which.
